description: The full card game of War — ties trigger real wars, with round counter, auto-play, and win detection.

faqs.a: Each player gets 26 cards. Higher card takes both; ties trigger a WAR — 3 face-down cards plus a deciding card.
Aces are high. If a player can't complete a war, they lose immediately.
faqs.q: Which card wins? What if someone runs out mid-war?

faqs.a: The round counter tracks every battle, and the log shows the last few results.
Yes — toggle Auto-play to watch battles resolve automatically, or play round by round.

howto: Press Battle to flip the top cards.
title: War Card Game
